title: Month 1's orders
headline: Morten plays the month on the GM's plan: delve floor 1 under the tower, the tower saves.
prose: Floor 1 is the safe start: it's under the home hex, so no travel and no wandering checks, and its fights are budgeted for a level 1 wizard. Every floor further out is a day or more away and level 4 or deeper, except floor 2 (D5, 4 days).

bullets.label: Before going down
bullets.text: sells the Sage's Book to the trader (+12 GP 5 SP) and leaves all 60 GP 2 SP 5 CP in the tower, so a death costs nothing.

bullets.label: The tower
bullets.text: saves its 100 GP. If the purse and the floor's coins bring it to 200 GP at the domain turn, it buys Farms in A3.
